job.prompt: Create a side-by-side before-and-after website comparison illustration for a SaaS marketing page. Left side labeled 'Before': an outdated 2008-era B2B industrial website mockup with cluttered layout, tiny text, low-contrast colors, table-based product grid, basic navigation bar, and a generic 'Contact Us' form at the bottom. Right side labeled 'After': the same company's content modernized in a clean, professional product page with structured product cards, hero image, clear blue CTA buttons, mobile-responsive layout, professional typography, and a structured RFQ form. A subtle glowing arrow or transformation effect in the middle connects the two sides. The 'Before' side uses muted gray-beige tones; the 'After' side uses crisp white and blue (#0d93e8). 16:9 aspect ratio.
